headline: This share has risen 721% in 7 months! From ₹85 to ₹695, why is the share running?
summary: STL shares rose about 721% in seven months, from ₹85 to ₹695. The company reports a record order book of ₹18,618 crore and a ₹1,500 crore QIP.
why: Sterlite Technologies is an Indian maker of optical fibre and network solutions. Demand for fibre tied to AI and data-centre build-outs is a key driver of its order flow.
why_moved: The stock rallied sharply as investors responded to a record order book, growing optical fibre demand from AI and data centres, and a ₹1,500 crore QIP.
